name: skillvault-author
title: SkillVault Author
description: [remove] Alone: the catalog. Text: create or change it. Author and maintain skill bundles and catalog entries in the SkillVault repository, not application source or installed copies. Shorthand: /sv-author. Overlaps with VS Code's agent-customization skill on writing SKILL.md files; use this one only for skills in the SkillVault repository and its catalog. Never installs; use skillvault-install to install the result.
author: wzlwit

inputs.name: action
inputs.description: Menu word: remove. Alone, the skill confirms a target clear from the conversation or shows the catalog and asks; other text creates or changes that skill. Operation-specific approvals still apply.

inputs.name: nameOrUrl
inputs.description: Existing repository skill name to edit, new skill name to create from scratch, or source URL; an external skill URL is added as a reference by default. A name does not automatically import an installed copy. Omit it to see the catalog or confirm a target clear from the conversation.

inputs.name: repoPath
inputs.description: Explicit SkillVault checkout, named in plain words such as in C:\path\skillvault. Relative to the working project; must pass Git-root and origin verification. Does not select the installation destination.

examples: /skillvault-author a skill that ranks PR comments
